_comment: The paper's race pages. Which story a race makes is the game's to decide (the police first, then the King,
rematches, pink slips, an event won, wrecks, upsets, big money, a first win); the words are here. Each headline
pool gives one line at random. In the player's races: {p} the player, {r} the rival, {pPossessive} and
and their {playerCarShort}/{rivalCarShort} (no year), {eventName}, {wager}, {winner}, and for a wreck {who},
{whoPossessive}, {whose}, {car}, {carShort}. The suffixes are added to a body when they apply.
{loserCarShort}, {where}, {record} (the record line, when the car had 5 wins or more), {carWins}.

news.busted.headline: {p} Nabbed After Street Race
Police Break Up Race; {p} Arrested
lines.news.busted.body: Officers broke up a race between {p} and {r} and took {p} in. The {playerCar} went to the police impound.
news.escaped.headline: {p} Gives Police the Slip
Racer Outruns Patrol Cars
lines.news.escaped.body: Patrol cars chased {p}'s {playerCar} after a race against {r}, and came back empty-handed.
news.king_beaten.headline: The King Is Dead
{p} Dethrones the King
A New King on the Street
lines.news.king_beaten.body: {r} lost for the first time in anybody's memory. {p} beat him {where} and drove off with his {rivalCar}.
news.king_won.headline: The King Keeps His Crown
{r} Sends {p} Home on Foot
lines.news.king_won.body: {p} took a shot at {r} and lost, and the {playerCar} went with it. The King's record grows.
news.rematch_won.headline: {r} Loses Again
No Revenge for {r}
lines.news.rematch_won.body: {r} wanted a rematch with {p} and got one. It went the same way: {p} won {where} and took the {rivalCar} too.
news.rematch_lost.headline: {r} Gets Even
Sweet Revenge on the Street
{r} Settles the Score
lines.news.rematch_lost.body: {r} had been waiting for a rematch since {p} took {rivalPossessive} car. {r} won it {where}, and now drives off in {pPossessive} {playerCar}.
news.pink_won.headline: {p} Takes {rPossessive} Pink Slip
{r} Walks Home
Pink Slips Change Hands
lines.news.pink_won.body: {p} raced {r} for pink slips {where} and won. {r} signed over the {rivalCar}.
news.pink_lost.headline: {p} Loses {playerCarShort} to {r}
{r} Takes {pPossessive} Car
lines.news.pink_lost.body: {p} put the {playerCar} up against {r} for pink slips {where}, and lost. The car is {rPossessive} now.
lines.news.suffix.rival_crashed: What's left of the {rivalCar}, that is.
lines.news.suffix.revenge: {r} was heard saying this isn't over.
news.event_won.headline: {p} Wins the {eventName}
{eventName} Goes to {p}
lines.news.event_won.body: {p} beat {r} {where} in the {playerCar} to win the {eventName}.
news.wreck.headline: {who} Wrecks {whose} {carShort}
Race Ends in a Wreck
lines.news.wreck.body: A race between {p} and {r} ended with {whoPossessive} {car} off the road. {winner} took the win.
news.upset.headline: Upset: {p} Beats {r}
Nobody Saw {p} Coming
lines.news.upset.body: {r} was supposed to win this one. {p}'s {playerCar} had other ideas {where}.
news.big_money.headline: {wager:money} Race Goes to {winner}
Big Money on the Street
news.first_win.headline: New Face on the Street
{p} Gets a First Win
lines.news.first_win.body: A newcomer, {p}, beat {r} {where} in a {playerCar}. Keep an eye on this one.
lines.news.rivals.record: The car had {carWins} wins to its name.
news.rivals.pink_wreck.headline: {winner} Tows Away {loserPossessive} Wreck
Pink-Slip Race Ends in a Wreck
lines.news.rivals.pink_wreck.body: {loser} wrecked the {loserCar} racing {winner} for pink slips {where}. {winner} towed away what was left.{record}
news.rivals.pink.headline: {winner} Takes {loserPossessive} {loserCarShort}
{loser} Loses {whose} Ride
lines.news.rivals.pink.body: {winner} beat {loser} for pink slips {where}, and drives the {loserCar} home.{record}
news.rivals.wreck.headline: {loser} Wrecks {whose} {loserCarShort}
Another Wreck on the Street
lines.news.rivals.wreck.body: {loser} put the {loserCar} into something hard racing {winner} {where}.
